description: Fixed geometry-only development pilot. Presets declared before model scores. No fitting or scoring.

parameter_descriptions.seed: Integer seed shared by copies. Independent NumPy PCG64 streams per contiguous period and for noise versus dropout. Same seed pairs rate/noise comparisons.
parameter_descriptions.grid_hz: Canonical output rows per second. Reference labels and periods retain their exact reader grid.
parameter_descriptions.fold_plan_sha256: SHA-256 of the immutable development fold plan; checked before loading raw files.
parameter_descriptions.source_hz: Sampling rate of raw source frame clocks, not the upsampled reader output.
parameter_descriptions.raw_files: Exact relative paths under --external-root and SHA-256 for every raw input, including labels read only by the baseline reader.
parameter_descriptions.observation_hz: Requested sensor rate, capped at source_hz. Select nearest source tick per period, ties forward; use actual selected source times. No synthetic observations above the source rate.
parameter_descriptions.noise_std_m: Independent zero-mean Gaussian standard deviation in metres PER x/y coordinate, for every player and ball observation. Height unchanged. No clipping or correlation.
parameter_descriptions.ball_bursts_per_minute: Poisson start rate per minute of metadata period time, including existing gaps. Exponential waiting times restart each period; overlapping bursts form a union.
parameter_descriptions.burst_min_s: Minimum uniform burst duration in seconds before clipping to the period end.
parameter_descriptions.burst_max_s: Maximum uniform burst duration in seconds before clipping to the period end.
parameter_descriptions.fold: Unchanged fold number of the original game; copies are dependent diagnostics, not new independent matches.
parameter_descriptions.fold_key: Exact game identifier used in the frozen fold plan and development allowlist.
parameter_descriptions.provider: Selects the corresponding existing reader and observed-only adapter.
parameter_descriptions.source_revision: Pinned public dataset revision already recorded by the repository.

stress_timing.grid: Row i is i/25 seconds on the source-aligned reader clock; gt and period are copied without remapping.
stress_timing.mapping: native_timestamps_s[j] is the actual selected raw observation time, mapped to grid_index[j] = floor(time*25 + 0.5). Samples leaving their period are rejected.
stress_timing.source_index: NPZ source_index indexes the native arrays; source_frame gives the original provider frame ID.
stress_timing.missingness: Only mapped rows may contain observations. All other geometry rows are NaN. Raw missing detections and pre-existing canonical xy gaps remain NaN. No interpolation or hold.
stress_timing.speed: Backward displacement between consecutive coarse observations divided by their actual elapsed seconds. NaN at each period start and across any missing native track frame, even one not sampled.
stress_timing.masks: NPZ observation_mask marks selected sensor ticks, including ticks with missing detections. ball_dropout_mask marks selected ticks covered by a burst; all three ball channels there are NaN.
stress_timing.rate_limit: SkillCorner is native 10 Hz: its 15 Hz preset has effective 10 Hz observations and is identical to the corresponding 10 Hz preset at the same seed. It cannot test true 15 Hz acquisition.
stress_timing.burst_counts: dropped_ball_observations counts finite xy lost specifically to bursts; dropout_grid_rows includes already missing observations. Unselected rows are not counted as burst losses.

baseline_timing.grid: Exact existing-reader arrays on the 25 Hz canonical grid; gt unchanged. DFL period is supplied separately from raw FrameSet clocks.
baseline_timing.native_mapping: DFL row i corresponds to source_frame = period first frame + (i - period grid start); a 250-row synthetic inter-half gap is retained. SkillCorner native frame f has time f/10 and maps to floor(2.5*f+0.5).
baseline_timing.interpolation: SkillCorner baseline retains existing-reader linear 10-to-25 Hz interpolation between adjacent finite detections; baseline finite rows must not be treated as measured observations. Stress copies reopen detected-only native geometry.
baseline_timing.reference: Only the unchanged existing readers read reference fields, to construct the baseline reference. The corruption function receives no reference arrays.

idsse_J03WMX.description: Original DFL development game, CC BY 4.0, IDSSE / Sportec / DFL.
idsse_J03WMX.clock_description: Within each GameSection, raw N advances at 25 Hz. Reader concatenates firstHalf, 250 empty grid rows, secondHalf. Native timestamps use this concatenated clock, not wall time; source_frame retains raw N.

skillcorner_1925299.description: Prior SkillCorner development game in expanded_team_training.json, MIT; credit SkillCorner.
skillcorner_1925299.clock_description: Native frame f has time f/10 seconds, matching the existing reader. match_periods supplies half-open native frame ranges independently of phases. Canonical period/gt use the reader floor mapping.

hz10_noise0p5.description: 10 Hz requested, 0.5 m xy standard deviation, 2 Poisson burst starts per minute, uniform 2-6 s duration.

hz15_noise0p5.description: 15 Hz requested, 0.5 m xy standard deviation, 2 Poisson burst starts per minute, uniform 2-6 s duration.

hz10_noise2.description: 10 Hz requested, 2 m xy standard deviation, 2 Poisson burst starts per minute, uniform 2-6 s duration.

hz15_noise2.description: 15 Hz requested, 2 m xy standard deviation, 2 Poisson burst starts per minute, uniform 2-6 s duration.
